title: ORACLE Psi rebuilt on current ICARUS main and hardened
summary: The ORACLE latent-pressure / ICARUS Psi possibility layer has been rebuilt on current main rather than merging its stale draft branch. The clean reconciliation preserves PARALLAX/DREAMSTATE and MCP Evolution, adds the actual ORACLE Psi trader tab, and hardens temporal/probabilistic semantics: confidence-weighted coverage, distinct-domain consensus, RFC3339 non-future external evidence, observation-time TTL expiry, neutral-pressure abstention, no duplicate cross-asset force counting, and no fabricated same-snapshot unexplained residual. Exact-head Linux/Windows CI is pending before merge.
